title: 📢Community Event: "What's on my desk?"
content:
## _Hello everyone!_

## _We are excited to announce our first community event:_

## **_"What's on my desk?" 🎉_**

This event is all about sharing the unique and creative setups of your workspaces. Whether it's your home office, studio, or any place where you get things done, we want to see it!  


* * *

# **How to participate:**

  1. Take a photo of your desk or workspace.

  2. Share it in **@General board as a post.**

  3. Add a brief description of your setup and any interesting items you have on your desk

  4. **Don't forget to add the tag "whatsonmydesk"!**




* * *

We can't wait to see your amazing workspaces! Let's connect with fellow community members and see how they work. 🖥️✨

** _Happy sharing!_**

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Wait, I need to clean up my desk first... 😵

Comment 2: It’s really exciting news! 🏄 If creative workspaces are shared, it will surely lead to a wealth of ideas and collaboration, inspiring even more remarkable outcomes. 👖 Does the workspace... or desk need to be specifically related to fashion, or can it be open to other fields as well?
Reply 1: Hi! It doesn't have to be related to fashion! Feel free to share anything on your desk that you want to share!💫
content_description: Join our community event, "What's on my desk?" to showcase your unique workspace and connect with fellow members!

title: CLO-SET File Download Problem
content:
After completing the rendering process, when I click the download button, a new tab opens with the message "Missing query parameter," and the download does not start. This issue does not occur when I click the download button for older render files, but I am experiencing this problem with all render files I create from now on.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/561659185a454026b1afad83e927197c/images/74a16a363fbf477297e20f6b5d1638b4CC56A55B-2BE7-4AE5-AEBF-FEF83F16CD34.webp)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Thank you for your report. If there were special characters in the file name, there was an issue with downloading. It just has been fixed. Please check it again!

Comment 2: Hi, please send your query in to tech support here: https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/requests/new
content_description: This web page aims to address the "Missing query parameter" error encountered during the download process of newly created render files, while providing solutions and troubleshooting tips.
